changelog: v002: added 50 stage-01 principles (011-060) covering cross-timeframe influence, session structure, level quality and evidence calibration; each labeled with the strength of its empirical support.
no_lookahead_policy: All generated chart-flow examples use closed candles only. Decision examples retain their source review status.
source_policy_note: Stage 01 principles 011-060 are original restatements distilled from trading doctrine and published empirical research. No book, paper or website text is reproduced. Each carries evidence_strength (strong/moderate/weak/untested) and evidence_sources at record level.
training_order: The train.jsonl file is intentionally ordered from principles to sequence flow to level/volume examples to decision-contract examples.
